payload.description:
**Blocked by:** every route requires a principal.

Gherkin first, before any of the three changes below: two members of one organization read and post in one channel; a bot named once in an organization is the same teammate to everyone; a file one bot saves is continued by another bot and by a person.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.
payload.title: Specify shared channels and organization teammates
